card.name: Respiratory depression monitoring warnings in opioid labels
card.fires_on: Words in opioid label warnings about respiratory depression, mainly "closely" after "Monitor patients" and "depression" after "respiratory". It also fires on "occurred" or "failure" in similar risk statements.

modes.label: The warning to monitor closely
modes.description: The word "closely" right after "Monitor patients" in a warning about breathing problems.
modes.example: Monitor patients<< closely>> for respiratory depression, especially within the first

modes.label: Respiratory depression
modes.description: The word "depression" after "respiratory" in a monitoring instruction.
modes.example: Monitor for respiratory<< depression>>, especially during initiation of Hydrocodone

modes.label: Risk outcome verbs and nouns
modes.description: The word completing a statement of a serious risk, such as "occurred" or "failure".
modes.example: The risk of acute liver<< failure>> is higher in individuals with underlying liver disease
